newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ConsRutile says 96/97 profit to fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ConsRutile says 96/97 profit to fall.

text.p: Mineral sands miner Consolidated Rutile Ltd said on Tuesday that 1996/97 profits would fall due to lower production from its operations at North Stradbroke Island off the coast of southern Queensland.

The company, which is controlled by mining house RGC Ltd following a bid for ConsRutile's parent Cudgen RZ Ltd earlier this year, said the lower output would be due to relocation of one of the two dredging operations until January 1997. "This lower level of production from Australian operations will have a flow-one effect on sales volumes and revenues and result in lower profits for the 1996/97 year," ConsRutile said.
The company said earlier that 1995/96 net profit rose to A$16.99 million from A$12.34 million a year ago. Sales were slightly higher at A$75.15 million from A$74.99 million.

It said the result in the year to June 30 did not include a A$5.30 million loss from its half share in Sierra Leone rutile mining operations, which were suspended in January 1995 as the result of a rebel military attack. The company has A$80.7 million invested in the West African operation. "The outlook for the Sierra Leone operation is for a continuation of losses at the current level until such time as a decision to restart production is made," it said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
